title: Dragon's Eye Ritual
description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a large dark dragon with glowing red eyes breathing a stream of blue energy into a floating eye. Below, a cloaked red figure stands on a rocky path holding a lantern, while a giant woman's face with closed eyes emerges from the ground near a sailing ship on dark water. The composition is framed by ornate floral borders with glowing blue flowers.
prompt: Intricate black and white fantasy illustration with selective glowing blue and red accents, a massive coiled dragon with red eyes breathing swirling blue energy into a floating eye that drips liquid, a red cloaked figure holding a lantern on a stone path, a giant woman's face emerging from the earth, a small sailboat on reflective water, ornate floral border with glowing blue flowers, aurora borealis in the night sky, mystical and surreal atmosphere
